subject: QBR: Cross-functional sprint check for upcoming Velocity pilot launch
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha.patel@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR: Cross-functional sprint check for upcoming Velocity pilot launch

Team —

Quick kickoff on the QBR prep + launch readiness for Velocity (Zephyr pilot). We have 2 weeks until the pilot starts and leadership wants a crisp slide set for Friday's QBR. I want a short status update in this thread (one line each) for the following areas by EOD tomorrow:

- GTM / demo readiness (who will own the demo flow during pilot)
- Enablement + deck status (enablement deck + 1-pager for AE handoff)
- Pricing approvals & legal note on trial terms
- Docs freeze and highlight of any missing KB articles
- Support runbook & escalation path (on-call + SLO expectations)

I've attached a working enablement deck and the latest pricing summary. Please confirm blockers and any ask of me or leadership.

Attachments: enablement_deck_v2.pdf, pricing_summary_v3.xlsx

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha.patel@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR: Cross-functional sprint check for upcoming Velocity pilot launch

Marcus / all —

GTM / Demo: demo flow is baked; Markus (PM) and I did a dry run yesterday. I recommend a 15m focused demo + 10m Q&A for pilot kickoff. Need: a short slide that flags known limitations (latency at long contexts when quantized) — I can draft.

Docs: aiming to freeze public-facing KB by Thu EOD. Outstanding items:
- Quickstart for Zephyr security checklist (priority)
- FAQ on data routing / private deployment expectations (TBD)

I'll add links to the Drive folder. No blockers for QBR deck, but would appreciate the final pricing cell from Tessa to call out expected unit economics.

Laura Bennett
Senior Product Marketing Manager
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR: Cross-functional sprint check for upcoming Velocity pilot launch

Enablement: deck feedback — I reviewed enablement_deck_v2.pdf and left comments on slides 4 and 7 (handoff checklist and support expectations). Current ETA for final enablement deck: Thu 12:00pm PT. Will produce a single-slide AE playbook + a ~1 page cheat sheet for customer-facing AEs.

Questions: who will run the first AE office hours during pilot week? I can host if we want a product-led session, otherwise recommend pairing Steph (AE lead) + me.

Attachments: enablement_deck_v2.pdf (comments)

-Stephanie
Senior Manager, Developer Advocates

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR: Cross-functional sprint check for upcoming Velocity pilot launch

Pricing / Legal: pricing_summary_v3.xlsx contains the recommended trial terms (90 day pilot, capped monthly spend of $15k, opt-in telemetry for perf baseline). Legal has a couple minor redlines around data retention; they want explicit language about audit logs and exportability — should be resolved by Thursday.

I'll update the pricing cells for the QBR slide tonight. If leadership wants a concession ask (credits), we should flag it now so finance can pre-clear.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Pricing Strategy

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: zephyr-ops@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR: Cross-functional sprint check for upcoming Velocity pilot launch

Support: runbook draft attached (support_runbook_draft.md). Current on-call rotation confirmed. Key risks: initial token surge could increase error rates for gateway timeouts — Ops will autoscale but we need to call out fallback policy (route to smaller model variant) in the runbook.

Escalation path: support -> infra on-call -> Marcus (GTM ops) -> VP Eng if severity P0 beyond 30m. SLOs to include in slide: 95th latency target 450ms for 1k qps baseline; error budget for pilot 1.5%.

I pulled telemetry hooks for the Pilot Dashboard (link in Drive). No blocker, but recommend a pre-launch smoke test on Wed evening to validate autoscale thresholds.

Attachment: support_runbook_draft.md

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Support & Success

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha.patel@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Cross-functional sprint check for upcoming Velocity pilot launch

Thanks for the quick turn. Summary / asks before I pull together the QBR slide:

- Laura: please add the "known limitations" slide and link to the Zephyr quickstart KB.
- Stephanie: finalize enablement deck + one-pager by Thu 12:00pm PT; host AE office hours on Mon 02/23 unless we hear otherwise.
- Tessa: update pricing_summary_v3.xlsx with legal redlines; call out whether we need a pre-approved credit cap.
- Grace: add the fallback routing policy into support_runbook_draft.md and confirm smoke test time (I can block 7pm PT Wed).

I'll assemble a 3-slide QBR summary (status, risks, asks) and circulate by Thu EOD for review. If anyone expects a change that would materially affect go/no-go, flag immediately.

Marcus
Head of GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
